channel.title: Independent app guides by Ahmet Kamer ÇİVİ
channel.description: Practical guides for small habits, retro photos and used-car viewings.

item.title: A reading habit that starts with two pages
item.description: Set up a small reading routine, try the free weekly worksheet, then keep check-ins visible on your iPhone.

item.title: iPhone’da eski fotoğraf efekti
item.description: Ücretsiz 1895 görünümü, gerçek önce–sonra örneği ve arkadaşlarınla deneyebileceğin kadrajlar.

item.title: Compare two used cars
item.description: A free, editable worksheet for prices, mileage, seller claims, evidence and mechanic questions. Download or print your notes.

item.title: Same friends, another time: 1895, 1972 and 2004
item.description: Shared laughs, picnics and evenings with friends, through 1895, 1972 and 2004. Compare nine Nostalgia Camera outputs and keep your photo card.

item.title: A seven-day plan for one small habit
item.description: A practical worksheet for choosing a clear action, making it easy to start, and reviewing what actually happened.

item.title: How to compose for a digicam look on iPhone
item.description: A small photo walk: six everyday subjects, one camera look, and a way to choose the frames you want to keep.

item.title: What to ask before a used-car viewing
item.description: A question sheet you can print or keep on your phone, from the first seller message to the independent inspection.
